assumptions: Production ranks cover the selected season's weekly rosters as the host recorded them; value ranks cover the CURRENT rosters on the live board. They are different rosters at different times and are ranked separately.
Each starter's points count once, at his own position: a WR in FLEX is WR production. FLEX is an allocation, not a position.

The league starter standard for a position-week is the score of the N-th best rostered player at that position, where N is how many players at that position the league's optimal lineups actually started that week. Free agents are not in the pool.
The host records a bye, an inactive week and a scoreless game as the same 0.0.
Positional dynasty value counts players only (no picks) and never includes an unpriced player as zero.
This league sets lineups manually: production figures are the HYPOTHETICAL optimal lineup, and observedSubmittedPoints shows what the submitted lineups actually scored. The two are never mixed.

diagnoses.explanation: Lineup points came from one of the league's oldest starting groups (points-weighted age 27.97, rank 1/4 oldest).

assumptions: The team's roster in its last included week is replayed across every included week, plus the player being asked about.
Uses realized points (ex post): this is not a decision evaluation.
No roster cap, transaction cost or waiver competition is modelled.
A replayed teammate with no recorded points that week is unknown, not zero; a week counts only when the answer is the same whatever he would have scored.

notComputed.freeAgentPoints: Weeks a player was on no league roster are not sourced in V1.
notComputed.lineupEntryProbability: Forward-looking LEP is owned by src/roster_intel/best_ball_utility.py and is not part of V1.

overall.note: Diagnoses are evidence for review. None of them is a transaction.

priors.status: labelled PRIORS, not calibrated. Every threshold below decides only whether a diagnosis is shown for review. None of them changes a value, a rank, a lineup or a recommendation to transact.

why.contenderBenchMinCount: Count of never-started, never-league-startable owned players at or above which a PUSH team's bench is flagged for review.
why.developmentalMaxAge: Age at or below which a low-start player is read as developmental rather than redundant. Per-position prior, not an age cliff.
why.lowContributionStartRate: Below this share of eligible owned weeks in the optimal lineup a player is tagged low_contribution (descriptive only).
why.minOwnedWeeks: Fewer owned weeks is too small a sample to call a player low-contribution.
why.quartileFraction: A 'top' or 'bottom' position rank is the league's top or bottom quarter, ceil(n x 0.25), so it scales with team count instead of a fixed rank.
why.redundantMarginalPerOwnedWeekMax: Marginal optimal-lineup points per eligible owned week at or below which a top-quartile-value player is called lineup-redundant on THIS roster.
why.thinCoverageMinHoles: Dedicated-slot holes (unfilled or 0-point starter weeks) at or above which thin coverage is considered.
why.veteranMinAge: Age at or above which a starting player is tagged productive_veteran. Per-position prior, not an age cliff.
